description: Enrols a11ign/a11ign in the shared preset in a11ign/.github (#5222, epic #5153). FLAG: `enabled` below. REVERT: set it to false. The preset ships disabled, enables every built-in manager, and automerges, so this file narrows it to custom regex managers only: Dependabot already reads `uses:` in .github/workflows (dependabot.yml, #3775), and a second manager would open the same bump twice. Every `a11ign/...@<sha>` pin the tree holds is either read by a custom manager or named in ignorePaths with its reason in renovate-config.test.ts.
